entries.title: The Agency Machine — Portrait
entries.prompt: Monumental classical marble bust fused with industrial machinery, gears, robotic arms, documents and acquisition pipelines. Lime brushstroke obscures eyes. Heroic upward gaze, dense but legible central composition. No headlines, logos, watermarks or generated text. No generic stock photography, cash piles or glossy SaaS gradients.

entries.title: The Agency Machine — Landscape
entries.prompt: Landscape companion to portrait. Same bust and texture on right, panoramic machinery and document conveyor, quieter warm-paper blueprint negative space on left. Redesign composition, not a stretch. No headlines, logos, watermarks or generated text. No generic stock photography, cash piles or glossy SaaS gradients.

entries.title: The Anti-Broker
entries.prompt: Defiant marble figure with lime eye stroke breaking free from tangled telephone cords, obsolete machinery and discarded scripts. Angular torn geometric planes and dramatic diagonal movement; intellectual rebellion, not violence. No headlines, logos, watermarks or generated text. No generic stock photography, cash piles or glossy SaaS gradients.

entries.title: The Capital Engine
entries.prompt: Exploded engineering diagram of a capital engine: interlocking gears, document intake, intelligence modules, routing paths and relationship networks. Clear visual flow on paper; diagrammatic, sparse, technical. No headlines, logos, watermarks or generated text. No generic stock photography, cash piles or glossy SaaS gradients.

entries.title: The AI Workforce
entries.prompt: Central marble human operator overseeing a coordinated group of robotic assistants, mechanical hands, circuit boards and terminals. Oversized geometric blocks; readable at thumbnail size. No headlines, logos, watermarks or generated text. No generic stock photography, cash piles or glossy SaaS gradients.

entries.title: The Automation Factory
entries.prompt: Chaotic documents and messages enter a robotic assembly line and emerge as orderly records. Conveyor, gear stations, arrows and high-contrast industrial silhouette. No headlines, logos, watermarks or generated text. No generic stock photography, cash piles or glossy SaaS gradients.

entries.title: Do the Damn Math
entries.prompt: Oversized vintage mechanical calculator operated by marble hand; measurement tools, abstract equations and financial diagram fragments. Bold cutout geometry, no invented numerical claims. No headlines, logos, watermarks or generated text. No generic stock photography, cash piles or glossy SaaS gradients.

entries.title: The Capital Network
entries.prompt: Two sculptural marble hands forming a handshake, abstract nodes and radiating mechanical pathways. Sparse technical diagrams and lime connections; no corporate handshake photography. No headlines, logos, watermarks or generated text. No generic stock photography, cash piles or glossy SaaS gradients.

entries.title: The Operator’s Manual
entries.prompt: Open field manual on workbench, annotated plans, index cards, mechanical pencils and a marble hand. Tactical editorial composition; avoid readable invented documents. No headlines, logos, watermarks or generated text. No generic stock photography, cash piles or glossy SaaS gradients.

entries.title: The Resource Vault
entries.prompt: Enormous industrial vault opens onto blueprints, manuals, archives and organized knowledge assets, not money. Lime light from vault, rich black ink texture. No headlines, logos, watermarks or generated text. No generic stock photography, cash piles or glossy SaaS gradients.

entries.title: Notes From the Trenches
entries.prompt: Experimental workbench with dismantled prototypes, crossed-out technical sketches, handwritten marks and fragments; iterative design studies on warm paper. No headlines, logos, watermarks or generated text. No generic stock photography, cash piles or glossy SaaS gradients.

entries.title: The Starting Line
entries.prompt: Classical marble athlete breaking through angular paper layers toward bold lime path, blueprint fragments and directional arrows. Signature lime eye stripe, energetic movement. No headlines, logos, watermarks or generated text. No generic stock photography, cash piles or glossy SaaS gradients.

entries.title: Launch
entries.prompt: Single marble hand activating mechanical ignition switch, lime electrical energy and compact engineering grid. Centered square composition, generous margins. First in coordinated four-stage series. No headlines, logos, watermarks or generated text. No generic stock photography, cash piles or glossy SaaS gradients.

entries.title: Originate
entries.prompt: Industrial horseshoe magnet attracting documents, relationship nodes and opportunity signals; lime acquisition pathways. Match stage 1 central-object scale, margins and texture. No headlines, logos, watermarks or generated text. No generic stock photography, cash piles or glossy SaaS gradients.

entries.title: Automate
entries.prompt: Compact machine with gears, robotic arms, circuitry and orderly document outputs; lime connections. Match stage 1 central-object scale, margins and texture. No headlines, logos, watermarks or generated text. No generic stock photography, cash piles or glossy SaaS gradients.

entries.title: Scale
entries.prompt: Central industrial machine expands to smaller machines and distribution nodes; multiplying gear structures and lime pathways. Controlled expansion, no wealth promise. Match stage 1 framing. No headlines, logos, watermarks or generated text. No generic stock photography, cash piles or glossy SaaS gradients.

entries.title: Capital Rebel
entries.prompt: Isolated Greco-Roman marble bust in three-quarter view looking slightly upward, signature rough lime stroke across eyes, distressed engraving and selective lime silhouette edge. Entire head, shoulders and base visible with transparent margins. No outside objects or shadows. No headlines, logos, watermarks or generated text. No generic stock photography, cash piles or glossy SaaS gradients.

entries.title: FAB. — Publication logo
entries.prompt: Precisely rendered FAB. lettermark in black condensed bold lettering, lime rectangle, thick black border, hard-offset black shadow, red period, isolated with transparent margins.

entries.title: Collage and texture kit
entries.prompt: Transparent separated asset sheet: three rough lime brush strokes, torn paper, halftone patches, grid fragments, gears, arrows, circular stamps without text, marble hand fragments, connecting lines, hazard stripes, ink smudges. Each object isolated with ample separation; no overlapping. No headlines, logos, watermarks or generated text. No generic stock photography, cash piles or glossy SaaS gradients.
